title: Universal Life Insurance Service Desk Rules: Reinstatement of Lapsed Policies
content:
## Rules

A lapsed Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy may be reinstated on the owner's signed application with evidence of insurability satisfactory to underwriting.

**Window.** The reinstatement application must be signed no later than the lapse date plus the tier's reinstatement window months. The window end is found by adding the number of calendar months to the lapse date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; an application signed on the window end is in time. The lapse date is read from the policy record and the signature date from the reinstatement application on the service record.

**Approval.** The policy is reinstated only on a reinstatement application whose request status is approved.

**Reinstatement premium.** The reinstatement premium is the monthly deductions that fell due during the grace period before the lapse, plus the tier's further months of deductions (3 on every tier) at the current monthly deduction, divided by one less the tier's premium load percentage up to target, rounded to the cent.

**Effects.** The surrender charge schedule resumes as if the policy had not lapsed; a loan extinguished at lapse must be repaid or reinstated; a no-lapse guarantee lost before the lapse is not restored; and statements in the application are contestable for the tier's contestable period from the reinstatement date. A surrendered policy cannot be reinstated.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; window of 60 months)

| Lapse date | Window end | Application signed | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 August 2021 | 12 August 2026 | 12 August 2026 | Yes |
| 12 August 2021 | 12 August 2026 | 13 August 2026 | No |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2029 (29 February 2029 does not exist) | 28 February 2029 | Yes |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2029 | 1 March 2029 | No |

## Worked reinstatement premium (hypothetical)

An Ashgrove Indexed UL Growth (load up to target 5%) lapsed after two monthly deductions of $180.00 fell due in the grace period; the current monthly deduction is $190.00. The premium is $360.00 plus three months of $190.00, $570.00, which is $930.00, divided by 0.95: $978.95.
